name: Priority Matrix
description: Sort your tasks by urgent and important: do, schedule, delegate or drop them.
prompt: An Eisenhower priority matrix with four coloured quadrants, do it now, schedule it, delegate it and drop it, where I add tasks to a quadrant and tap a task to complete, move or delete it.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Ordena tus tareas por urgentes e importantes: hacer, planificar, delegar o descartar.
